selection_reasoning: Single atomic crafting task requiring the player to craft a lapis block from 9 lapis lazuli using a nearby crafting table. Straightforward, observable, and verifiable with no obscure domain knowledge requirements.

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted lapis_block ends up in the player's inventory after crafting. The player starts with 9 lapis_lazuli (not lapis_block), so this rule is not pre-satisfied. After crafting 9 lapis lazuli into 1 lapis block via the crafting table, the item will appear in inventory.

scene_description: A simple outdoor crafting scene in a jungle biome where the player spawns with 9 lapis lazuli in their inventory and must use a nearby crafting table to craft a lapis block. The crafting table is placed 3 blocks east and 2 blocks south of spawn on the surface, with a torch beside it for visibility.
task_text: You have 9 lapis lazuli in your inventory. Find the nearby crafting table and craft a lapis block.
design_notes: Minimal scene — player spawns with all needed materials (9 lapis lazuli) and just needs to reach the crafting table ~3.6 blocks away at (~3, ~0, ~2). A torch at (~3, ~0, ~3) marks the location. The /fill command replacing dirt with grass is cosmetic (jungle biome already has grass — confirmed harmless via sandbox). The task requires: (1) locate crafting table, (2) right-click/use it, (3) place 9 lapis lazuli in 3x3 grid, (4) take lapis block from output.
